'''Falsewings α''' is a [[Common enemy]] in ''[[Arknights: Endfield]]''.

{{Enemy description|The "Psuthopteron Anavon" (archive ID: ARA07Cα) is an energized variant of the ARA07C. Most observers regard color as the only differentiating feature between the Anavon and the basic variants.}}

==Overview==
A unique variant of [[Falsewings]], Falsewings α have similar appearance with their counterpart, but it doesn't make them more of the threat; Aside from a shot, which deals Æther damage, they can create a moving whirlwind that deals continuous Æther damage and slows Operators in it.
